task: Locate an open-source conversational AI model on Hugging Face, trained in English and list its main features and applications.
answer: Model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) - an open-source (Apache-2.0 licensed), English-trained conversational AI model on Hugging Face, found via Models filters: Task=Text Generation, Language=English, License=apache-2.0. Main features: instruction-tuned causal language model with 1.54B parameters (1.31B non-embedding), 28 layers, transformer architecture with RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, Attention QKV bias and tied word embeddings, GQA with 12 Q heads and 2 KV heads; full 32,768-token context length with up to 8,192-token generation; significantly improved knowledge, coding and mathematics capabilities; multilingual support for 29+ languages including English. Applications: conversational chatbots and role-play (condition-setting for chatbots), instruction following, generating long texts (over 8K tokens), understanding structured data such as tables, generating structured outputs especially JSON, and coding/mathematics assistance.
